data.name: Quasar
data.gender_notes: Quasar is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'quas' meaning 'how great' and 'asar' meaning 'shining' or 'bright'. A distant, bright, shining star. The name Quasar carries the meaning “A distant, bright, shining star” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Latin tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Quasar usually hope their child will grow to embody a distant, bright, shining star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Quasar carries the aspiration that its bearer grows in a distant, bright, shining star and lives a life of faith and good character.
data.etymology: Quasar belongs to the Latin linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “A distant, bright, shining star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quasar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The name Quasar can serve as a reminder to seek the brightness and brilliance within, rather than relying on external sources for illumination.
